title: Quick Sweet Filipino Blood Dinuguan
description: A plant-based Filipino dish featuring almond extract and lacquer-glaze, perfect for a post-workout snack. This sweet and crumbly dinuguan is made with tofu and plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large pan over medium heat and add the chopped onion and minced garlic.
Cook until the onion is translucent, then add the crumbled tofu and cook until it is lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the almond extract, lacquer glaze, vinegar, soy sauce, and maple syrup.
Pour the glaze mixture over the tofu and onion mixture, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve the dinuguan hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
